verdict: Leads arriving at good cost, but a mid-week delivery halt demands attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 30 leads at an average cost of $46.95 per lead — and in the most recent 7-day window, lead volume rose 22% while spend fell 39%, a meaningful efficiency gain. That momentum was interrupted on September 9–10, when Meta ad delivery halted completely with $0 spent and zero leads on both days; this was not a scheduled pause, and the cause is being resolved now. Separately, all 30 leads that arrived this period show no record of advancing to a consultation or next step, which points to a gap in the intake process rather than an ads issue — that pipeline leak is being addressed directly. Delivery has been prioritized for restoration before the week closes, and once stable, the strong cost-per-lead trend from the prior 7 days should reassert itself.
